subject: Renewal onboarding: approval queue, SLA exceptions, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@heliohealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — onboarding checklist and questionnaire

Hi Mina / Jonas,

We're nearing our contract renewal window (Aug 1). We want to:
- Renew for 12 months (term change from 6 -> 12)
- Add a 30% capacity uplift for Q4 traffic (burst-priority)
- Refresh vendor onboarding in your procurement portal so our security team can re-certify

I've attached our completed vendor questionnaire (Helio_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf). A few specific asks from my side:
1) Can Redwood accept a single PO for the renewal + uplift (PO 5498)?
2) We have one compliance item: per-tenant audit logs for 365 days — will that require a Private deployment or can it be scoped in Dedicated?
3) We may need a temporary SLA exception to cover the burst window Nov 15–Dec 31 — is that process internal or via the portal?

Let me know the fastest path to get the onboarding evidence into your procurement queue; our procurement team prefers portal uploads and DocuSign for final SOW.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Procurement Lead, HelioHealth
procurement@heliohealth.com

Attachments: Helio_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — onboarding checklist and questionnaire

Hi Elena — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear asks. Short plan so we have alignment and a single place to track approvals:

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Today: I confirm receipt and upload evidence to the Redwood procurement portal (I will tag your company record HLH-5498).
- By Jul 18: Our onboarding ops team (Jonas) will validate the questionnaire and flag any missing evidence in the portal comments.
- Jul 19–22: Pricing and legal coordinate on SOW finalization and DocuSign routing — I will attach SOW_Draft_v2.docx to the portal for your review.
- Jul 23: Approvals queue — procurement PO and billing team confirm the single PO path; Rishi will triage SLA exception for burst window.

A few answers up-front:
- Single PO: yes, we can accept one PO for the renewal + uplift; please include the PO number in the portal upload (Helio PO 5498). Our billing team prefers PO + invoice net-30 by default; if you need net-45 we can escalate.
- Audit logs: 365-day retention can be scoped on Dedicated with an evidence addendum; it does not require a Private deployment. We'll surface the retention profile in the portal entry.
- SLA exception: process starts with an internal SLA exception form + legal approval. Rishi will confirm the path and whether it's approved prior to DocuSign.

Action items for you:
1) Please upload the signed PO and any additional attestation PDFs to the procurement portal record (link below).
2) Review SOW_Draft_v2.docx and add comments in DocuSign or directly in the portal so legal can pick up redlines.

Portal link: https://redwood.app/procurement/portal/HLH-5498

I'll upload the initial evidence bundle now.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Customer Success — Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Draft_v2.docx
From: Elena Torres <elena@heliohealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — onboarding checklist and questionnaire

Thanks Mina — I've uploaded the signed PO (Helio_PO_5498.pdf) and a short attestation about our data handling into the portal (file attached). We also confirmed internally that net-45 payment is preferred.

Two quick questions:
1) Are there any gating evidence items that will block procurement from approving before Jul 23 (so we can prioritize those)?
2) Who will be the DocuSign sender for SOW? If you plan to send, please cc our legal contact (l.chen@heliohealth.com).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Helio_PO_5498.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@heliohealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — onboarding checklist and questionnaire

Elena / Mina / team — looping in a couple final operational notes.

1) SLA exception: Approved provisionally for Nov 15–Dec 31 (burst window) pending legal signoff. We've completed the SLA_exception_form.pdf internally and attached it to the portal record; legal will route final approval within 48 hours. This provisional approval covers prioritized capacity throttles and a fallback to the next-cost tier if we hit sustained 95th percentile CPU usage over a 24h window.

2) Payment terms: We can accept PO 5498 and accommodate Net-45, but finance will apply an invoice hold flag until the final SOW is executed. That will not block provisioning for the uplift — ops can stand up reserved capacity once onboarding evidence is validated.

3) Evidence gating list (please confirm items we've flagged):
- Completed SOC 2 attestation (uploaded) — OK
- Data handling attestation (portal upload) — OK
- Network allowlist entries for Helio IP ranges (action by Helio) — MISSING
- Contact for audit access and 365-day log retention commitment (action by Helio) — PARTIAL

Jonas — please validate the portal evidence this afternoon and post any missing items directly as portal comments (so procurement picks them up automatically). Mina — once portal evidence is green, move the request into the approvals queue and select the SLA exception item so legal sees it inline.

Elena — can you get the Helio network allowlist to us (CIDR blocks) and confirm the audit contact by Jul 24? If you can, we'll maintain the provisioning timeline and aim to have capacity uplift available for early Nov testing.

I'll be the DocuSign sender for the SOW and will cc l.chen@heliohealth.com.

Thanks — Rishi

Attachment: SLA_exception_form.pdf
